Name: CSFF Mod Framework
Author: Jared
Description: Standalone framework for CSFF mods. Provides mod discovery, data loading, map cache indexing, WarpData resolution, sprite loading, blueprint/perk injection, localization, STA activation, NPC agent diagnostics, WorldMap node injection, Portal Hub System (cross-mod world switching via portable Portal Hub), a declarative Animal System (tame/companion, traps/bait, spoor tracks, encounters — all authorable from a species JSON manifest with no mod-side C#), and standalone GameModifierPackage/flavour-synergy injection.
